name: Auto Salary Entry Save
script:
from_date = doc.from_date
to_date = doc.to_date

total_days = frappe.utils.date_diff(to_date, from_date) + 1

salary_strucs_assign = frappe.get_all(
    "Salary Structure Assignment",
    fields=["*"],
    filters=[
        ["docstatus", "=", 1]
    ],
)


attendances = frappe.get_all(
    "Attendance",
    fields=["*"],
    filters=[
        ["attendance_date",">=", from_date],
        ["attendance_date","<=", to_date],
        ["docstatus", "=", 1]
    ],
)

if not attendances:
    frappe.throw("No attendance found")

doc.set("salary_list",[])
# frappe.msgprint(f"{salary_strucs_assign}")
for sal in salary_strucs_assign:
    
    filterd_att = []
    for x in attendances:
        if x.employee == sal.employee:
            filterd_att.append(x)
            
    # frappe.msgprint(f"{filterd_att}")
    
    if len(filterd_att) == 0:
        continue
    
    total_late_enter = 0
    total_present_days = 0
    total_present_seconds = 0
    total_absent_days = 0
    working_hours_per_day = 0
    total_working_hours_per_day = 0

    current_date = from_date
    
    while current_date <= to_date:
        current_att = []
        for x in filterd_att:
            if f"{x.attendance_date}" == current_date:
                current_att.append(x)
        
        is_holiday = False

        if len(current_att) > 0:
            att = current_att[0]
            
            total_late_enter = total_late_enter + att.late_enter_time.total_seconds()
            
            if att.status == "Present":
                total_present_seconds = total_present_seconds + att.total_time.total_seconds()
                total_present_days = total_present_days + 1
            if att.status == "Absent":
                total_absent_days = total_absent_days + 1
                        
            shift_type = frappe.get_all(
                "Shift Type",
                fields=["end_time", "start_time"],
                filters=[
                    ["name","=", att.shift_type],
                ],
            )[0]
            total_working_hours_per_day = total_working_hours_per_day + ((shift_type.end_time - shift_type.start_time).total_seconds() / 60/60)
            
        else:
            # ===============================================
            if doc.holiday_from == "Holiday List":
                holiday_List = frappe.get_all(
                    "Holiday",
                    fields=["*"],
                    filters=[
                        ["parenttype","=", "Holiday List"],
                        ["parent","=", doc.holiday_list],
                        ["holiday_date","=", current_date],
                    ],
                )

                is_holiday = len(holiday_List) > 0
            # ===============================================    
            if doc.holiday_from == "Company":
                holiday_comp = frappe.get_all(
                    "Company",
                    fields=["default_holiday_list"],
                    filters=[
                        ["name", "=", doc.company]
                    ],
                )[0]
                holiday_List = frappe.get_all(
                    "Holiday",
                    fields=["name"],
                    filters=[
                        ["parenttype","=", "Holiday List"],
                        ["parent","=", holiday_comp.default_holiday_list],
                        ["holiday_date","=", current_date],
                    ],
                )
                is_holiday = len(holiday_List) > 0
            # ===============================================        
            if doc.holiday_from == "Employee":
                
                holiday_emp = frappe.get_all(
                    "Employee",
                    fields=["holiday_list"],
                    filters=[
                        ["name", "=", sal.employee]
                    ],
                )[0]
                
                
                if holiday_emp.holiday_list:
                    holiday_List = frappe.get_all(
                        "Holiday",
                        fields=["name"],
                        filters=[
                            ["parenttype","=", "Holiday List"],
                            ["parent","=", holiday_emp.holiday_list],
                            ["holiday_date","=", current_date],
                        ],
                    )
                    is_holiday = len(holiday_List) > 0
                else:
                    if doc.req_for_all:
                        frappe.throw(f"Please assign default holiday list to ({sal.employee} - {sal.employee_name}) company")
            
            if is_holiday:
                # log(holiday_List)
                total_present_days = total_present_days + 1
            else:
                total_absent_days = total_absent_days + 1
        
        current_date = frappe.utils.add_days(current_date, 1)
        
    working_hours_per_day = total_working_hours_per_day / total_present_days
    total_working_seconds = working_hours_per_day * 3600  # Convert working hours to seconds

    # frappe.msgprint(f"Working Hours Per Day: {working_hours_per_day}")
    # frappe.msgprint(f"Total Late Time: {total_late_enter}")
    # frappe.msgprint(f"Total Present Days: {total_present_days}")
    # frappe.msgprint(f"Total Present Seconds: {total_present_seconds}")
    # frappe.msgprint(f"Total Absent Days: {total_absent_days}")
    
    salary_doc = frappe.get_doc("Salary Structure", sal.salary_structure)
    # 3. Access Earnings and Deductions

    earnings = [{
        'salary_component': e.salary_component,
        'amount': e.amount,
        'type': e.type
    } for e in salary_doc.earnings]
    
    deductions = [{
        'salary_component': d.salary_component,
        'amount': d.amount,
        'type': d.type
    } for d in salary_doc.deductions]
    
    total_salary = 0.0
    for e in earnings:
        total_salary = total_salary + float(e['amount'])
    for d in deductions:
        total_salary = total_salary - float(d['amount'])
    
    salary_per_second = total_salary / total_days / total_working_seconds if total_working_seconds else 0
    
    salary_discount =  (salary_per_second * total_late_enter) + (salary_per_second * (total_absent_days*total_working_seconds))
    
    final_salary =  total_salary - salary_discount
    row = {
        "doctype": "Auto Salary Entry Table",
        "employee": sal.employee,
        "employee_name": sal.employee_name,
        "net_salary": final_salary,
        "discount_salary": salary_discount,
        "present": total_present_days,
        "absent": total_absent_days,
    }
    
    doc.append("salary_list", row)
    
    frappe.msgprint(f"Emp: {sal.employee_name}, Net Salary: {frappe.utils.ceil(final_salary)}, Salary Discount: {frappe.utils.ceil(salary_discount)}, Present {total_present_days}, Absent: {total_absent_days}, Total Salary {total_salary}")
    # frappe.msgprint(f"Salary Discount: {(salary_discount)}")   
    # frappe.msgprint(f"Salary Per Second: {salary_per_second}")   
    # frappe.msgprint(f"Salary: {frappe.utils.ceil(final_salary)}")

    # Step 2: mark shifts as excluded if not included or explicitly excluded

             limit=0,

    else:

    from_date_filter = frappe.utils.add_days(from_date, 0)

    query = f"""
        SELECT distinct *
        FROM `tabEmployee Checkin`
        WHERE time BETWEEN DATE('{from_date_filter}') AND DATE('{to_date_filter}')
        ORDER BY
            time ASC
    """
    
    checks = frappe.db.sql(query, as_dict=True)
    
    shift_assignment = frappe.get_all(
                    "Shift Assignment",
                    fields="*",
                    filters=[
                        ["start_date", ">=", from_date],
                        ["end_date", "<=", to_date],
                        ["docstatus", "=", 1],
                    ],
                    order_by= "start_date desc",
                    limit=0
                )
                
    shifts_type = frappe.get_all(
                    "Shift Type",
                    fields="*",
                    limit=0
                )
                
    manual_attendance = frappe.get_all(
                "Attendance",
                fields="*",
                filters=[
                    ["docstatus","=",1],
                    # ["status","=","On Leave"],
                    ["attendance_date",">=",from_date],
                    ["attendance_date","<=",to_date]
                ],
                limit=0,
        )
        
    def get_shift_type(shifts_type, shift_name):
        for shift in shifts_type:
            if shift.name == shift_name:
                return shift
        return None
        
    def seconds_to_hhmm(seconds):
        
        if seconds == 0:
            return "00:00:00"
        hours = int(seconds // 3600)          # 18000 // 3600 = 5
        
        remaining_seconds = seconds % 3600    # 18000 % 3600 = 0
        minutes = int((remaining_seconds + 29) // 60)  # (0 + 29) // 60 = 0
        
        if minutes >= 60:
            additional_hours = minutes // 60
            hours = hours + additional_hours
            minutes = minutes % 60
    
        return f"{hours:02d}:{minutes:02d}:00"
        
    def get_date_checks(checks, date):
        current_date_checks = []
        for log in checks:
            if log.time.date() == frappe.utils.getdate(date):
                current_date_checks.append(log)
        
        return current_date_checks
    
    def get_shift_checks(current_date_checks, shift):
        start_range_seconds = shift.start_time.total_seconds() - (shift.begin_check_in_before_shift_start_time * 60)
        end_range_seconds = shift.end_time.total_seconds() + (shift.end_check_out_after_shift_end * 60)
        shift_checks = []
        for log in current_date_checks:
            if log in shift_checks:
                continue
            
            check_time = frappe.utils.get_time(log.time)
            check_time_seconds = (check_time.hour * 3600) + (check_time.minute * 60) + check_time.second
            
            if check_time_seconds >= start_range_seconds and check_time_seconds <= end_range_seconds:
                shift_checks.append(log)
        shift_checks.sort(key=lambda x: x.time)
        return shift_checks
    
    def get_shift_duration(shift_type):
        start_time_seconds = frappe.utils.get_timedelta(shift_type.start_time).total_seconds()
        end_time_seconds = frappe.utils.get_timedelta(shift_type.end_time).total_seconds()
        total_shift_seconds = (end_time_seconds - start_time_seconds)
        return total_shift_seconds
        
    def calculate_shift_status(emp_id, current_date, shift_type, checkin, checkout):
        
        first_in_time = frappe.utils.get_time(checkin.time)
        first_in_seconds = (first_in_time.hour * 3600) + (first_in_time.minute * 60) + first_in_time.second
        
        last_out_time = frappe.utils.get_time(checkout.time)
        last_out_seconds = (last_out_time.hour * 3600) + (last_out_time.minute * 60) + last_out_time.second
        # Convert shift times to seconds
        start_time_seconds = frappe.utils.get_timedelta(shift_type.start_time).total_seconds()
        end_time_seconds = frappe.utils.get_timedelta(shift_type.end_time).total_seconds()
        total_shift_seconds = (end_time_seconds - start_time_seconds)
        
        if last_out_seconds <= start_time_seconds:
            last_out_seconds = 0
        
        # Allowed margins
        allow_check_in_seconds = shift_type.allow_check_in * 60
        allow_before_check_out_seconds = shift_type.begin_check_out_before_shift_end * 60
        
        # Late entry calculation
        late_enter = first_in_seconds - start_time_seconds
        if late_enter <= allow_check_in_seconds:
            late_enter = 0
        
        
        # Early exit / extra time calculation
        extra_time = last_out_seconds - end_time_seconds
        early_exit_time = 0
        
        if last_out_seconds != 0:
            if extra_time < 0:
                early_exit_time = abs(extra_time)
                extra_time = 0
        else:
            extra_time = 0
            early_exit_time = 0
            late_enter = total_shift_seconds / 2
    
        # Adjust first_in and last_out within shift bounds
        if first_in_seconds < start_time_seconds:
            first_in_seconds = start_time_seconds
        if last_out_seconds > end_time_seconds:
            last_out_seconds = end_time_seconds
    
        # Calculate total worked time
        total_time = total_shift_seconds - late_enter - early_exit_time
    
        if total_time <= 0:
            total_time = 0
    
        # Determine status
        status = "Present"
        #if total_time <= (total_shift_seconds / 2):
        #    status = "Half Day"
        
        results = {
            "total_time" : total_time,
            "status": status,
            "late_enter": late_enter,
            "early_exit_time": early_exit_time,
            "extra_time": extra_time
        }
        # if current_date == '2025-10-01' and emp_id == 'HR-EMP00010':
        #     frappe.throw(f"{results} , {shift_type.name}")
        return results
    
        
    
    
    calculated_attendaces = []

        for log in checks:
            if log.employee == emp_id:
                emp_checks.append(log)
        
        if emp_checks is None or len(emp_checks) == 0:

        emp_calculated_att = []

            if is_manual:

            emp_shift_assign = None

            emp_calculated_shifts = []
            
            for current_shift in emp_shifts:

                    att_record = {

                 #تعديل احتساب التأخير او نسيان البصمة

                    att_record = {

        hours = int(seconds // 3600)

        minutes = int((remaining_seconds + 29) // 60)

    begin_checkout_seconds = sh.begin_check_out_before_shift_end * 60
    last_checkout_seconds = sh.end_check_out_after_shift_end * 60
    
    start_time_seconds = sh.start_time.total_seconds()
    end_time_seconds = sh.end_time.total_seconds()

    start_range_seconds = sh.start_time.total_seconds() - start_checkin_seconds
    end_range_seconds = sh.end_time.total_seconds() + last_checkout_seconds
    
    shift_checks = []
    for log in current_date_checks:
        if log in shift_checks:
            continue
        
        check_time = frappe.utils.get_time(log.time)
        check_date = frappe.utils.getdate(log.time)
        check_time_seconds = (check_time.hour * 3600) + (check_time.minute * 60) + check_time.second
        
        if sh.end_next_day:
            next_date = frappe.utils.getdate(frappe.utils.add_days(current_date, 1))
            current_date_date = frappe.utils.getdate(current_date)
            end_day_seconds = frappe.utils.get_timedelta("23:59:59").total_seconds()
            
            if check_time_seconds >= start_range_seconds and check_time_seconds <= end_day_seconds and check_date == current_date_date:
                shift_checks.append(log)
                
            if check_time_seconds >= 0 and check_date == next_date and check_time_seconds <= end_range_seconds:
